title: Femtosecond laser-structured wastepaper as a biodegradable flexible current collector for supercapacitor applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37152-37165
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06223C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Qasim, Abdul Kareem, Oussama M. El-Kadri, Ali S. Alnaser
Wastepaper is converted to a high-performance, low-cost, and biodegradable flexible current collector for supercapacitors via femtosecond laser structuring and metal ion-induced chemical crosslinking.
